answer.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification test to improve time-to-value, activation, and retention without sacrificing durable revenue. Do not respond with broad discounting: the recovered 40% SMB discount produced strong acquisition but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, indicating poor sustainability despite the competitor’s price cut. Activation messaging can support the test, while results should be monitored by qualified revenue, renewal behavior, and churn among price-sensitive SMBs.
